#include "quantum.h"

void led_init_ports(void) {
    DDRB |= (1<<1); // OUT
    DDRB |= (1<<2); // OUT
    DDRB |= (1<<3); // OUT
}

/* LED pin configuration
 * Caps Lock: Low B1
 * Side1: Low B3
 * Side2: Low B2
 */
